title: Rules.
bodyText: Subject to chapter 91, the director may adopt rules necessary for the enforcement and administration of this chapter. The rules shall have the force and effect of law.
bodyHtml: [§398-11]  Rules.  Subject to chapter 91, the director may adopt rules necessary for the enforcement and administration of this chapter.  The rules shall have the force and effect of law. [L 1993, c 152, §1]
